meta.name: deepchem
meta.description: Molecular ML with diverse featurizers and pre-built datasets. Use for property prediction (ADMET, toxicity) with traditional ML or GNNs when you want extensive featurization options and MoleculeNet benchmarks. Best for quick experiments with pre-trained models, diverse molecular representations. For graph-first PyTorch workflows use torchdrug; for benchmark datasets use pytdc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测分子性质，加速化学与药物研发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速评估大量分子的ADMET和毒性等性质
copy.tagline_en: Predict molecular properties to accelerate drug discovery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly evaluate ADMET and toxicity properties for many molecules

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取化学分子数据（如 SMILES、SDF）、生成数值特征、训练与评估模型，也能用 MoleculeNet 基准数据和预训练模型做性质预测。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理分子数据（SMILES、SDF 等）、预测分子性质（溶解度、毒性等），或训练/评估机器学习模型时触发。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read molecular data (SMILES, SDF), generate numerical features, train and evaluate models, and use MoleculeNet benchmarks and pretrained models for property prediction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to process molecular data, predict molecular properties (e.g., solubility, toxicity), or train/evaluate ML models.

say_en.text: Predict the solubility of this molecule using DeepChem.
say_en.note: It will read SMILES and output a prediction.

say_en.text: Train a GNN on the Tox21 benchmark dataset.
say_en.note: Loads dataset and trains a graph neural network.

say_en.text: Fine-tune ChemBERTa on my small dataset.
